data.short_meaning: Seventh month of the Islamic calendar
data.long_meaning: Rajab is the seventh month of the Islamic calendar. It is considered a sacred month in Islamic tradition. In some countries, it is the month when pilgrims from all over the world come to Mecca to perform the Hajj. The name Rajab carries the meaning “Seventh month of the Islamic calendar” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rajab usually hope their child will grow to embody seventh month of the islamic calendar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
